protectedAreas.name: Märkedalen nature reserve
protectedAreas.relevance: Directly on-route. Hallandsleden page says the route passes through Märkedalen, and Länsstyrelsen says Hallandsleden goes through the reserve.
rules: Do not break branches, fell or otherwise damage living or dead standing/fallen trees or bushes.
Do not collect invertebrates, lichens or mosses in ways that damage or destroy their habitats or reproduction environments.
Do not set up signs, placards or inscriptions; do not dig or damage natural objects/surfaces.
Do not drive motor vehicles except on roads.
Do not have tents, caravans or campers in the reserve between 24:00 and 06:00.
Dogs must be leashed, except for hunting/search exceptions.
Events, camps, competitions and certain scientific work require Länsstyrelsen permission.
protectedAreas.terrainSafety: Märkedalen has dramatic block slopes, cliff faces and steep slopes down toward Stora Neten, with about 70 m elevation difference and limited road access.
protectedAreas.currentness: Länsstyrelsen page showed no current reserve news on 2026-04-29, but did show a Halland forest-fire-risk banner linking to SMHI.
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Import as route-level protected-area rule and terrain safety note.

rules: Do not damage living/dead trees, bushes or branches.
